Bait Detection
Green: Your equipped fishing rod has valid bait attached.
Red: Your equipped fishing rod has no valid bait attached.

Bonus Time
Green: You are currently inside the configured fishing bonus time window.
White: You are outside the bonus time window.

Shore Detection
Red: Your current aim position is detected as near shore.
White: Your current aim position is not near shore.

Weather Detection
Green: Current weather improves fishing.
White: Current weather has no effect.
Red: Current weather makes fishing worse.

Maximum cast/aim distance in tiles.
16 (default) uses the original vanilla distance check. Higher values enable the Better Fishing override.

Shore detection radius in tiles.
7 (default) keeps the original vanilla shore detection. Values 1-6 enable Better Fishing's lighter directional shore check with the selected radius.

Controls the near-shore shift toward smaller fish.
100%% (default) keeps vanilla strength. Any other value enables a custom strength; 0%% disables the near-shore size shift.
100%% (default) keeps the full vanilla temperature behavior. Any other value enables a flat Better Fishing modifier at all temperatures and replaces the vanilla temperature curve.

Catch chance multiplier during the bonus timeframes (percent).
100%% = no bonus.
Default: 120%%.

Disabled (default): uses the vanilla fish-size distribution table. Enabled: uses the Better Fishing Small/Medium/Big distribution. Vanilla skill/species weight limits are always preserved.
Note: This choice is applied when the world loads. Reload your save after changing it.
